function_declarations.name: doc_to_pdf
function_declarations.description: Render a Markdown or HTML document into a clean, branded, multi-page PDF via headless Chrome — the polished deliverable you'd hand a client, not a screenshot. Brand wrap (print-CSS + footer) is on by default; --no-brand for raw; --template for a custom shell. Never overwrites without --force. Use when the user says "make a PDF", "turn this into a PDF", "PDF this", "send them a PDF", "build a client doc", "export to PDF", "branded PDF".

title.description: Document title (used by the brand template)

no_brand.description: Skip the brand wrap (use the HTML as-is)

template.description: Custom HTML template with {{title}} and {{content}} placeholders

force.description: Overwrite the output PDF if it exists
